    records.append({'guard_task_metadata_created':(L/'fm/state/guard.meta').exists()})
    run(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-keyout',str(L/'key.pem'),'-out',str(L/'cert.pem'),'-days','1','-subj','/CN=api.typesafe.ai','-addext','subjectAltName=DNS:api.typesafe.ai'])
    ctx=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER); ctx.load_cert_chain(str(L/'cert.pem'),str(L/'key.pem'))
    class API(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self,*a): pass

    server.shutdown(); server.server_close()
finally:
